scope: Primary manufacturer/laboratory references; these sources do not calibrate the proposed assembled instrument

sources.title: H2dX Hydrophone User Guide
sources.supports: Typical sensitivity under specified phantom supply; dependence on preamp input, bias and cable; no detailed response plots. Nominal specifications do not supply per-unit complex calibration.

sources.title: PCB Model352C33
sources.supports: Accelerometer quantity, nominal100mV/g,5.8g sensor mass and published frequency range. The included amplitude calibration is not automatically assembled-chain phase calibration.

sources.title: PCB Model480E09
sources.supports: Unbuffered output; receiving input impedance affects low-frequency response; published low-frequency range uses1Mohm load.

sources.title: Modal Testing FAQ
sources.supports: Actual force applied to structure needs measurement; amplifier current/voltage is not a substitute in modal force FRFs; structure-side force-sensor placement matters.

sources.title: Underwater acoustics calibration for acoustic technology
sources.supports: NPL describes low-frequency pressure comparison5–315Hz,coupler reciprocity20Hz–2kHz,and free-field methods to250Hz. Methods and domains differ; no extrapolation from medical-ultrasound calibration.

sources.title: NPL AC1:Phase calibration of hydrophones by free-field reciprocity,10–400kHz
sources.supports: Phase response is a separate calibration task. This report frequency range does not validate musical-band calibration.

sources.title: optoNCDT 1220 / 1320 / 1420 family datasheet: CL1 footnotes and table
sources.supports: Class 1 maximum measuring rate is 4 kHz with 12-bit D/A; ILD1420-10CL1 linearity is below ±8 micrometres on the specified target. Code size and faster ADC scans do not establish installed dynamic diaphragm calibration.

sources.title: T-series stream data rates and interchannel delay
sources.supports: A scan and its individual channel samples have different epochs; interchannel delay must be included when phase matters.
